meta.name: antinet-doc-parse
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与数据科学家在构建RAG系统时，当需处理PDF/Word/Excel等多格式复杂文档，用此技能可自动触发三级解析降级，一键输出高置信度结构化Markdown与元数据，免去繁琐清洗，直接夯实企业知识库数据底座！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析多格式文档为结构化Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在构建知识库时需要解析各种格式的文档
copy.tagline_en: Parse multi-format documents into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to parse various document formats for your knowledge base

howto.what: Claude 会把已过安全扫描的 PDF、Word、Excel 等文档依次用三级解析器转成结构化 Markdown，并给出元数据、置信度和实际生效的解析器名；三级都失败则不输出残缺结果，改标记人工介入。
howto.when: 当你在搭建 RAG 系统、需要处理 PDF、Word、Excel 等复杂文档时，或密卷房 Worker 收到已通过安全扫描的文件时接管。

say.text: 这个合同的表格和作者元信息也一起提取出来
say.note: 输出含页数、表格数、作者等元数据

say.text: 解析这个 Word 文件，并告诉我用了哪一档解析器
say.note: 会返回实际生效的解析器名

howto.what_en: Claude turns security-scanned PDF, Word and Excel files into Markdown via three parsers tried in order, returning metadata, a 0–1 confidence score and the parser used. If all fail, it flags human review rather than partial output.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you build a RAG system or need to parse complex PDF, Word or Excel documents, or when the Mijuanfang Worker receives a file that passed the security scan.

say_en.text: Parse this PDF with antinet-doc-parse and give me Markdown plus confidence
say_en.note: Tries the three parsers in order and returns the result

say_en.text: Also extract the table and author metadata from this contract
say_en.note: Output includes page count, table count and author

say_en.text: Parse this Word file and tell me which parser tier was used
